label: Model
help: provider/id a new session starts on; unset, models.primary decides

label: Thinking
help: reasoning effort a new session starts with; unset is medium

label: Primary model
help: the main role; wins over model when both are set

label: Summarizer model
help: compaction and session titles; unset, the primary

label: Advisor model
help: naming one turns the advisor on; unset, it is off

label: Auto-review model
help: naming one turns the auto-mode reviewer on

label: Classifier checkpoint
help: naming one (english) runs the local permission classifier

label: Selector model
help: naming one picks the lines that explain a cut bash output

label: Fetch model catalog
help: false never fetches a provider's model list

label: Catalog refresh hours
help: age past which a session refetches the list (24)

label: OpenRouter routing
help: OpenRouter's provider object, sent verbatim; edit in config.json

label: Permission mode
help: the mode a run starts in; unset is auto

label: Classifier URL
help: the sidecar's address; unset, the daemon starts one

label: Classifier timeout ms
help: one decision's deadline

label: Classifier threshold
help: the confidence it acts on; unset is shadow mode, never fires

label: Classifier approves (old)
help: before approval existed: false waits for the user

label: Classifier approval
help: when it answers an auto-mode ask; unset is instant

label: Allow at
help: confidence at which it allows a command

label: Allow destructive at
help: confidence at which it allows a destructive one

label: Ask at
help: confidence below which it asks the person

label: Ask timeout s
help: after-delay's wait before it answers; 0 never hands over

label: Auto-background ms
help: a command running longer moves to the background; unset, never

label: Edit as grammar
help: send the patch language as a provider grammar

label: MCP
help: turn MCP servers on

label: MCP token store
help: where MCP OAuth tokens are kept

label: Prewarm kernel
help: boot the Python kernel at session open; unset is on

label: Global skills
help: home-root skills the catalog lists; edit in config.json

label: Stale plan reminder
help: turns before an untouched plan is mentioned

label: Plans directory
help: relative to the workspace; unset is .yi/plans

label: Family depth
help: how deep subagents may nest; unset is 1

label: Kernel slots
help: live kernels this machine holds at once

label: Isolation
help: placements a spawn may ask for; edit in config.json

label: Worktree lanes
help: start each root session in its own worktree

label: Lane slots
help: worktrees kept per repository

label: Land command
help: program and arguments that land a lane; edit in config.json

label: Alert tokens
help: a notice per multiple a session and its children cross

label: Alert USD
help: a notice per multiple of dollars a session crosses

label: Day alert USD
help: a notice per multiple spent in the local day

label: Compact at tokens
help: compact past this many tokens; unset or 0, the window decides

label: Open Review beside
help: open the Review pane beside a session that edits files

label: Telemetry
help: write one span per request, tool call and turn beside the session

label: Reveal pace %
help: the solo TUI's streaming speed; 0 paints at once

label: Solo keymap
help: the solo TUI's key bindings; edit in config.json
